Fix fray crash when lock.unlcok called by a wrong owner (#360)

Fix memory leak with FrayClassLoader (#361)

With FrayClassLoader, Fray loads the application classes at each
iteration. However, this may cause memory leak if the classes loaded 
in the previous iteration are not properly cleaned. This commit 
fixes several memory leaks: 
1. ReentrantReadWriteLockCache is not necessary
2. locks created in previous runs should be cleared
3. If a thread is registered as shutdown hook, we need to remove them.
4. Thread locals in main thread will keep the classloader loaded
